name: Little Blue Wings for the Blue Girl
source:
You are trapped in a pitch-dark, tiny room, with no door or window. You don’t know how long has passed, even though you're never hungry or thirsty either. The only way to keep your sanity is Renee, a mysterious girl who is trapped beside your room and shares an uncertain fate with you.

[From [url=https://mohenk.itch.io/little-blue-wings-for-the-blue-girl]itch.io[/url]]
